item.text: AssemblyAI supports redaction during transcription and an option to exclude unredacted text from its saved result. I’ll enable redaction for names, phone numbers, and SSNs, set `redact_pii_return_unredacted` to `false`, and request two-speaker labels. The script will leave transcripts in AssemblyAI for your retention job.
